title: Sakar International Recalls Tony Hawk Silver Metallic Multi-Purpose Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and retention system requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 12,655.

title: Westfield Outdoor Recalls Tents Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cabela's and Bass Pro Shops (Recall Alert)
summary: The tent's stove jack ring can deteriorate when exposed to high temperatures from contact with a stove pipe and create smoke inside the tent, posing a risk of injury from smoke inhalation. Units: About 5,050 (In addition, about 830 in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls Lawn Tractors Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The wheel hubs were not manufactured to specifications and can fail, causing the tractor to lose braking and propulsion, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 160 (In addition, about 30 were sold in Canada).

title: Samson International Recalls Cayden 9-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or serious injuries to consumers. Units: About 5,400.

title: Scholastic Recalls Shake Look Touch Books Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pom poms on the book can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 185,700 (In addition, about 1,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Segway Powersports Recalls Fugleman Utility Terrain Vehicles (UTVs) Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cockpit rear panel between the seats and the cargo bed can overheat and melt the plastic, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,100.

title: Adventure Sports Recalls Ceramic Pulleys for Cabrinha Switchblade and Drifter Kite Sailing Kites Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ceramic pulleys used in the recalled Switchblade and Drifter kiteboarding kites can cause the bridle line connection to break, which reduces performance in steering and control of the kite, causing the kiteboarder to lose control of the kite, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,950.

title: Aesop USA Recalls Bathroom Deodorizing Drops and Oil Burner Blends Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements and Violation of FHSA Labeling Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled products contain low-viscosity hydrocarbons which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Black Diamond Equipment Recalls PIEPS and Black Diamond Avalanche Transceivers Due to Risk of Loss of Emergency Communications
summary: The recalled transceivers may not switch from SEND mode into SEARCH mode. If this were to occur, the device would not be able to locate a skier in an avalanche, which could result in severe bodily harm or death if the skier is buried under snow. title: Daikin Comfort Technologies Manufacturing (formerly Goodman Manufacturing Company, L.P.) Expands Recall of Evaporator Coil Drain Pans to Include Those Installed with Non-Condensing Gas Furnaces Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The molded plastic drain pan located at the bottom of the evaporator coil can overheat, melt and deform, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 298,300 (In addition, about 44,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Epoch Everlasting Play Recalls Kidoozie Play Tents and Playhouses Due to Flammability Risk and Burn Hazard
summary: The fabric playhouses and play tents fail to meet an industry flammability standard for these products, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 251,600 (In addition, about 37,200 were sold in Canada).

title: First Choice Glass Baby Bottles Recalled by NUK Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The markings on the outside of the bottles contain levels of lead that exceeds the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 100 (In addition, 77 were sold in Canada).

title: KTM North America Recalls Closed Course Competition Motorcycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The motorcycle's connecting rod can break, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 3,310.

title: Ocean Technology Systems Recalls Underwater Communication Devices Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Water can leak into the recalled underwater communication device during a dive and penetrate into the battery pack, causing the battery circuit board to short and ignite after the dive, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500 (In addition, about 36 were sold in Canada).

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A fuse in the ATV's electrical system can fail during operation, which can result in sudden loss of engine power and headlights, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,750 (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada).

title: Aqualung Recalls i330R SCUBA Diving Computers Due to Injury and Drowning Hazards
summary: The recalled diving computers can fail to adjust to the user's altitude and display incorrect calculations for sea level dive times at altitudes exceeding 3,000 feet, posing injury (decompression sickness) and drowning hazards. Units: About 16,400.

title: Crye Precision Recalls LRB™ Leg Loops Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The buckle on the leg loops, when worn with a load-rated belt, can loosen and slip, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 300.

title: Monti Kids Recalls Toy Box with Bins Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A small dowel can become exposed and detach from the toy box, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,500.

title: Silicone Baby Toy Bear Activity Toys Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard; Manufactured by Konges Sløjd Denmark A/S
summary: The mirror can come out of the silicone bear cover if pushed, exposing sharp edges of the mirror, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 85 (In addition, about 18 were sold in Canada).

title: The Hammock Source Recalls Key West Knock Down Hammock Stands Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's
summary: The weld attaching the stand to the base can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 32,500.

title: Vichy Laboratoires Recalls LiftActiv Peptide-C Ampoules Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The glass packaging of the small, sealed vials (ampoules) can weaken over time and break when opened, posing a laceration hazard to fingers and hands. Units: About 206,200.
